description: 011h is a new-generation building platform with a mission to accelerate the transition to a sustainable built environment through eco-friendly, flat-pack buildings. the company contributes to the mitigation of two of humanity’s most pressing challenges: climate change and a shortage of affordable living.
tagline: accelerating the world's transition to sustainable building development

description: 9fin is the faster, smarter way to find leveraged finance intelligence. through an ai-powered data and analytics platform, 9fin centralizes everything that’s needed to analyze a credit or win a mandate in one place, helping subscribers win business, outperform their peers, and save time. product offerings include news alerts, financials, covenants, comparables, deal predictions, esg, and search.

albatross' ai-driven personalization platform aims to transform user engagement by solving a major pain point - outdated recommendations that lead to high churn and missed revenue for businesses in ecommerce, media, marketplaces, and more.

apaleo is the next-generation open hotel management platform. tts api- and cloud-based technology helps hospitality companies manage multiple properties, connect desired apps, and run daily operations in entirely new ways.

apoha is combining breakthroughs in physics to build a completely new type of computer: the liquid brain™. by enabling machines to process and understand sensory data in a fundamentally different way, the technology mimics neuron-like behavior within complex molecules and goes beyond the limitations of today’s computing systems.
tagline: a new kind of machine intelligence

description: araris biotech ag is pioneering the development of a novel, proprietary antibody-drug conjugate (adc)-linker technology. araris’ platform technology links highly potent cytotoxic agents to off-the-shelf antibodies, thus forming adcs.
tagline: high-performance adc linker technology for targeted cancer therapy

description: large language models have transformed language and content generation. but they process data point by point, and they cannot capture the structures and dynamics hidden across millions of interconnected data points. terrorist networks, money-laundering operations, defence threats, and disinformation campaigns do not reside in individual documents. they emerge from the patterns between them, and conventional ai was not built to see those patterns. arlequin was built to close that gap, not by building a european version of an existing architecture, but by originating a genuinely new one.
tagline: the intelligence platform building a new AI architecture

description: when it comes to ai adoption, the biotech industry faces a fundamental data quality problem. basecamp research is changing this by creating the world’s largest and first purpose-built genetic and protein function dataset, paired with frontier ai models.

for organizations operating in highly regulated industries, safety is an important concern. beams is a cutting-edge insights and artificial intelligence platform, which processes and analyzes millions of operational reports at scale to help companies and governments automatically identify, suggest, and monitor risks and hazards in critical business environments.
tagline: ai insights platform for highly regulated industries

description: through cutting-edge biotechnology, better dairy seeks to revolutionize the dairy sector by providing consumers with a more sustainable and cruelty-free choice in dairy products. by leveraging precision fermentation, better dairy creates dairy proteins without the need for traditional farming.

bexio offers modern, user-friendly, and cost-efficient cloud-based business software for smes. its vision is to become the leading sme cloud platform in the dach market by offering efficient, top-quality tools to help companies succeed.
tagline: business and accounting platform for smes

description: biognosys is a proteomics company specializing in mass spectrometry-based solutions for precise protein quantification and biomarker discovery. its paradigm shifting platform enables the comprehensive analysis of complex biological samples, aiding researchers in understanding cellular processes and diseases. biognosys' patented tools accelerate the drug development process, providing better diagnosis, and allowing patient specific treatment schemes.

current orthodontic treatments are costly, painful, and a huge burden on time and resources for both patients and orthodontists alike, resulting in a lengthy and frustrating start-to-end process. biolux’s lead product, orthopulse, is overcoming this challenge through an innovative laser therapy approach and user-friendly app for patients and orthodontists, accelerating the orthodontic process.

bnext is spain’s first mobile-only financial hub that is used and loved by hundreds of thousands of customers. bnext’s users have access to a wide range of financial services that are tailored to their specific needs (including loans, mortgages, insurances, and investments) – all without ever having to leave the bnext app.

buena’s vision is to become the leading rental housing brand. the complex and highly fragmented rental housing market is fraught with challenges for both landlords and tenants. by consolidating the entire chain between owner and resident, buena is building delightful experiences, trust, and convenience for both parties.
tagline: the next generation of digital smart tools for property management

description: two thirds of german hospitals operate at a loss, and every added burden stretches them even further. Inefficiencies run through every step, from admission to discharge, long before an invoice is sent. That's where calliora comes in: their AI platform sits on top of existing systems and follows every case, flagging gaps in diagnoses and evidence while the case is still open.

cheap drones are now a defining feature of modern conflict, and effective defense against them is both urgent and undersupplied. defenders are being forced to respond with interceptors that cost many times more than the threats they neutralize, and traditional air defense systems were simply not designed for this problem.

carthrottle is the leading online platform for car enthusiasts. it serves a vibrant community of millions of users, who follow the brand on its app and major social media platforms. as the largest cross-platform auto publisher, carthrottle creates and distributes engaging car content and works closely with advertisers looking to reach a highly engaged audience.
tagline: the internet's largest community for car enthusiasts

description: carvolution is reshaping car ownership with a fully digital car subscription service. by removing the hassle of ownership and the inflexibility of leasing, it enables consumers to drive their dream car through a convenient monthly subscription service instead of a long-term commitment.
tagline: the next generation car subscription service

description: the cedar platform allows users to trade tokenized carbon credits, renewable energy credits, and carbon forward contracts. its advanced matching engine empowers users to interact with pooled liquidity while maintaining control over the underlying assets.
tagline: next generation exchange for environmental assets

description: daedalean is developing a range of fully autonomous autopilot systems that can reliably replace the human pilot. the company is working with leading aerospace manufacturers and major evtol companies to specify, build, test and certify its systems and has demonstrated crucial capabilities on its path to certification for airworthiness. near-term, it can be used as a safety-enhancing support system for current human-operated air traffic.

drug discovery is slow, risky, and expensive. daltontx is changing this by building adaptive ai systems that integrate into scientific workflows, learn with every experiment, and support scientists in real time, creating an intelligence backbone for modern r&d.
tagline: powering the intelligence backbone of drug discovery

description: as ev adoption accelerates, the real bottleneck isn’t infrastructure - it’s energy. dejablue is turning flexibility into a strategic advantage by transforming charging networks into dynamic, revenue-generating energy assets.
tagline: powering flexible energy for the ev era

description: dropz is committed to making tap water more appealing. using proprietary technology, dropz offers consumers dissolvable compressed cubes that release a mix of essential vitamins and natural flavor to provide delicious hydration.
tagline: compact tablets for better, more flavourful hydration

description: most materials we need to reach net zero haven’t been invented yet. to change this and achieve current energy transition goals, existing chemical r&d processes need radical disruption.

enviria makes it radically easy for companies to access scalable solar energy solutions and the entire renewable energy ecosystem. it develops projects based on its engineering, procurement and construction (epc) expertise and financial engineering concepts, such as third-party financing models or smart matches between space availability and solar investments.

enway develops software and technology that makes municipal and other special purpose vehicles autonomous. autonomous sweeping makes city cleaning much more efficient, flexible, and reliable. on the path to autonomous city services, enway is working to establish fully electric, autonomous sweeping in controlled private ground environments, such as factories, waste management facilities, and warehouses. its technology stack comprises machine learning and computer vision to allow for autonomous high-precision navigation and real-time litter classification to adapt to the local environment.

obesity is one of the most widespread diseases of the 21st century and comes with a high risk of cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, cancer, and reduced life expectancy. treating obesity with drugs has, so far, not been effective, often resulting in unwanted side effects and failing to prevent the onset of obesity-associated complications.

ethos is a digital life insurance company based in san francisco that simplifies the process of acquiring coverage. its proprietary data platform streamlines the application, underwriting, and issuance of life insurance policies, without the need for medical exams or blood tests.

a significant challenge in protein-based therapeutics has been insufficient production within patients, with current methods failing to meet necessary yields, leaving many innovations unfulfilled. expressionedits is revolutionizing the genetic toolbox by mastering the design of both existing and synthetic introns, pivotal regulators of gene expression. this innovation ensures the efficient expression of complex therapeutic and industrial proteins across various host cells.

felmo is on a mission to become europe’s leading pet health brand and revolutionize the way veterinary medicine works. felmo makes vet services stress-free by offering an end-to-end solution for pet owners, combining at-home vet visits with a seamless digital experience via the felmo app.

flexion is building the shared intelligence layer - the “brain” - for the next era of robots. the team combines world-leading research and engineering from eth and nvidia, drawing on the best of reinforcement learning, generative ai, and simulation tooling. by tackling the most challenging layer of the robotics stack, flexion is creating a remarkable tech hedge that spans software to hardware, synthetic to real-world data, and simulation to physical deployments, all compounding into superior robotic intelligence.

forgis is the faster, smarter way to build and scale industrial automation. through an agentic development environment that unifies hardware orchestration, deterministic code generation, and automated testing, forgis centralizes everything needed to deploy and maintain automation in one place. this helps engineering teams reduce integration time, manage multi vendor systems, and improve uptime across complex factory environments. product capabilities include hardware setup, code generation for robots and PLCs, simulation, testing, and continuous updates.

genialis provides therapeutic intelligence with its supermodel of cancer biology. they develop and validate clinically actionable ai models informed by the world’s most ethnographically diverse cancer data sets to predict patient responses and guide treatment decisions for targeted inhibitors, immunotherapies, and other emerging therapeutic classes. genialis is trusted by pharma and diagnostics partners to transform medicine through data. the company is headquartered in houston, boston and ljubljana.
tagline: data science solutions for more effective drug development

description: givve is the all-in-one solution for companies to manage employee benefits and foster workforce loyalty. with its rechargeable mastercard® individually branded for customers, givve enables tax-free benefits, redeemable at over 36 million sites worldwide. its automated end-to-end platform gives employers tools to manage their incentive plans, while employees gain insights into their card transactions. in addition, givve offers an api to employers and partners for deep customization of the powerful givve infrastructure.

as biological foundation models gain traction, pharma research is entering a new phase. scientists can now test hypotheses computationally before stepping into the wet lab. but between model outputs and real scientific decisions, workflows remain fragmented, slow, and hard to reproduce. helical addresses this gap with a virtual ai lab designed to turn foundation models into decision-ready discovery systems. founded by operators across tech, machine learning, and clinical research, helical brings biologists and ml engineers into one shared environment. by unifying data, models, and results, the platform enables teams to move from hypothesis to validated insight at the speed of inference, transforming in-silico discovery into a scalable, reproducible engine for pharma r&d.
tagline: bio foundation models at the fingertips of scientists

description: one in three adults suffer from hypertension, and many are unaware of their diagnosis due to a lack of symptoms and limited options for blood pressure measurement. driven to change this, hilo developed a clinically accurate, reliable, and convenient blood pressure monitoring wrist device which can diagnose and monitor hypertension.

using ai-powered hyperspectral imaging, hypervision surgical's (hvs) goal is to make medical surgeries more precise, safer, and faster. founded by a team of clinicians, medical imaging and ai experts, hsv’s technology uses a “heatmap” tissue analytics system to provide surgeons with superior tissue margin insights and feedback for better tissue preservation, reducing adverse events and improving patient outcomes.
tagline: making surgeries more precise, safer, and faster

description: the immune system’s natural capacity to detect and eliminate abnormal cells may prevent the development of many cancers. however, cancer cells are often able to avoid detection and destruction by the immune system.
tagline: the next generation of novel immunotherapies

description: infinite roots is a technology-driven company using fermentation to create the next generation of sustainable foods from mushroom mycelia. It unlocks the potential of an overlooked kingdom of life – fungi – as a sustainable, accessible, and nutritious food source.
tagline: creating the food of the future from fungi

description: inkitt is the world’s first reader-powered publisher, providing a data-driven platform to discover hidden talents and turn them into globally successful authors.

insphero is a leading 3d in vitro technology company which modernizes drug discovery to fuel the next generation of breakthrough therapies. its innovative solutions enable the creation of realistic, miniature human organ models called "microtissues" that mimic the in vivo environment. these models allow for more effective, safe therapies to reach the clinic and enhance the accuracy of drug testing, reducing the need for animal testing and providing more reliable results.

jodel is the online platform to discover, follow and participate in relevant discussions with people nearby. contrary to other social networks that are typically based on connections deliberately chosen by users, the jodel network is driven by location.

juniqe is the online shop for fresh, eclectic art and accessories. it offers a handpicked selection of artworks by independent artists printed on various products, such as posters, canvases, acrylic glass, stationery, and home accessories.
tagline: the online shop for fresh, eclectic art

description: hr tasks are increasingly complex due to changing regulation and demographics, a shortage of talent (both tech- and soft-skills), higher expectations from employees, and challenges in performance management. kenjo is an hr software platform that centralizes and automates human resources processes for businesses, offering features such as employee onboarding, time tracking, performance management, and absence tracking.
tagline: hr & culture platform for engaged employees

description: in today's digital economy, there's a growing demand for flexible, convenient payment options. many, especially younger consumers, are avoiding credit card debt and seeking alternatives that let them pay on their own terms.

knowunity provides a user friendly mobile app that allows millions of students from around the world to have a great learning experience. using the knowunity platform, top students or “knowers” can create and publish educational content designed to help “learners” better understand course curriculum – all in their own language and tailored to their own country.

lakera is the first and only developer-first ai security platform. lakera empowers developers with the world’s largest ai vulnerability database to accelerate the secure development of ai products. lakera works with any ai model or modality and instantly provides enterprise-grade security for ai applications. with lakera, developers build with conviction and unleash the full potential of ai.
tagline: supporting ai teams to build safe, trustworthy products

description: legalfly’s vision is crystal clear: to orchestrate a paradigm shift in the legal domain and offer law practitioners worldwide unprecedented time and cost efficiencies.
tagline: the premier ai copilot for legal teams

description: hormones influence everything from metabolism to reproductive health, yet traditional monitoring methods are outdated—relying on infrequent, invasive blood tests. level zero health is changing this by developing the first continuous, real-time hormone tracking technology.
tagline: pioneering the future of hormone monitoring

description: lunaphore is a biotechnology company developing the next-generation spatial biology platform for immuno-oncology research and diagnostics. its full stack platform, ffex, combines microfluidics, artificial intelligence, and rapid staining technologies for enhanced precision and efficiency in analyzing tissue samples. this allows for detailed insights into tissue structures, supporting the development of better targeted treatments and aiding pathologists in making informed decisions. by automating and accelerating the diagnostic process, lunaphore aims to improve cancer research and treatment.
tagline: spatial biotech platform for immuno-oncology research and diagnostics

description: luya is the flavor-loaded plant-based alternative to meat that doesn't try to imitate meat. luya foods rescues organic okara - a by-product of tofu and soy milk production - from going to waste and turns it into delicious, nutritious food products.

compute is the new electricity and is essential for AI, science, and innovation. but today’s cloud platforms are slow, complex, and costly - built for hyperscalers, not builders. lyceum is changing that.
tagline: reimagining access to compute in the AI era

description: magaloop is the new-age marketplace for the multi-trillion dollar, highly fragmented fast-moving consumer goods (fmcg) market. the platform serves as a backbone for independent trading channels by connecting traders, manufacturers, and wholesalers.
tagline: the marketplace for independent fmcg retailers

description: next-generation spacecraft propulsion

medmira improves human health with its point-of-care diagnostics tests based on its proprietary rapid vertical flow technology tm platform. medmira’s tests detect infectious diseases such as hiv, hepatitis, and syphilis with only one drop of specimen. the platform offers unique advantages – in just a few minutes the tests deliver fda-grade results, independent of any lab infrastructure. in addition, several diseases can be detected in the same cartridge simultaneously (multiplexing).

antibodies are our immune system’s most sophisticated weapon against diseases and represent highly promising, but difficult to source therapeutics against a wide range of conditions. memo therapeutics is a biotech company developing best-in-class therapeutic antibodies to transform the lives of patients with virus infections and cancer.
tagline: mining the human antibody repertoire to discover new therapies

description: europe's factories hold centuries of production knowledge that has not yet been translated into deployable robotics. robots at work generate the data used to train better robots, so whoever deploys at scale first builds an edge that gets harder to close every year. the underlying technology has finally caught up with the opportunity. the window to move is now.
tagline: the deployment layer for industrial robotics

description: large language models (llms) have become a cornerstone of contemporary ai and foundational modeling, deeply impacting and disrupting a number of industries. however operational costs are high, leading to dominance by american tech giants like google’s deepmind, meta, and openai.
tagline: fast, open-source, and secure language models

description: morressier provides publishers and societies with workflows to transform scholarly communications. the morressier platform supports the entire pre-publishing journey, from hybrid and virtual conferences where research is shared in its earliest stages, to journal submissions, peer-review workflows, and ai-powered integrity checks.
tagline: organizing the world’s early scientific findings

description: n26 has a vision to change the world’s relationship with money for the better. n26 is a fully digital bank that’s redefining the banking experience by giving customers the freedom to bank in a way that works for them.

natif’s intelligent document processing technology turns documents into data in real-time. powered by its proprietary high-performance ai models and ocr, natif can analyze and classify a wide range of documents, and identify and extract relevant data. it uses visual information and reads documents as a human would, making the process extremely quick, accurate, and cost-efficient, immediately improving productivity.

the bottleneck holding back ai adoption isn't demand - it's the capacity to deploy compute reliably at scale. nscale is engineered specifically for this challenge: a vertically integrated hyperscaler delivering the full stack from gpu compute and networking to data services and orchestration software, across europe, north america, and asia.

pave offers credit building and loans to facilitate access to the financial system. with better data and comprehensive control of finances and spending, pave is an indispensable tool for its users to establish financial stability and independence.

as traditional resources dwindle and current renewable energy sources continue to struggle with intermittency and limited output issues, fusion offers a game-changing solution - a nearly inexhaustible, safe, and clean energy source. proxima fusion's team of nuclear physicists, engineers, and computer scientists from max planck institute, mit, and google, combines years of research, technological breakthroughs, and ai to drive the energy revolution forward.
tagline: a truly stellar source of energy

description: by acquiring and scaling highly profitable ecommerce merchants, razor group is making the most beloved consumer brands available to everyone.

redbiotec provides a disruptive, patented technology platform to develop and produce innovative therapies and biomanufacturing solutions based on protein complexes and engineered microorganisms. founded in 2006 as a spin-off of eth zürich, the company has since won several awards, including the renowned w.a. de vigier award.
tagline: technology platform to develop living medicines

description: relai is accelerating the mass adoption of crypto by making investment in bitcoin accessible and hassle-free. the ‘made in switzerland’ startup is building a proprietary bitcoin brokerage platform powered by the lightning network.

robinhood is a stock brokerage platform that allows customers to buy and sell u.s. stocks, options, etfs, and cryptocurrencies with zero commission. users can buy and sell assets, track market trends, and manage their portfolios all through the user-friendly robinhood app.

rosiereality is a new-age gaming company working on a modern family entertainment interface. It designs and builds experiences for families’ living rooms that span virtual and real worlds, bringing together on- and offline content, and creating virtual characters with emotional depth that intrigue parents and excite kids.
sanity group unlocks the health and wellbeing benefits of cannabis and makes cannabis and derived products widely accessible to consumers and patients across europe.

sennder is europe’s leading digital freight forwarder, offering shippers access to a connected fleet of thousands of trucks. in a traditional industry, sennder is moving fast and focusing on the digitization and automation of road logistics processes.

showheroes is europe’s leading, independent provider of video solutions for digital publishers and advertisers. its proprietary video platform consists of a library of thousands of unique video content clips, efficient video assets, playlist management, a sleek and modern video player, as well as cutting edge video advertising technology and in-depth reporting tools for both publishers and advertisers.
tagline: mobile video solutions for publishers and advertisers

description: spacex is transforming space exploration and connectivity through reusable rockets, spacecraft, and satellite technology. its falcon and starship vehicles are designed to make access to space more reliable, affordable, and scalable, while starlink is building a global satellite network to deliver high-speed internet connectivity around the world.

paris-based swap™ food, fka umiami, is a pioneer foodtech company that offers plant-based meat and fish filets. the key to swap's success is its groundbreaking "umisation" technology, which provides one of the few real alternatives to the current market standard - extrusion. this proprietary process creates juicy and thick cuts of plant-based meat that perfectly mimic the taste and texture of animal meat and fish.
tagline: plant-based whole cut meat and fish

description: accelerating enterprise software in the ai era
tagline: accelerating enterprise software in the ai era

description: mobile first tax assistant
the global media platform

for the last 20 years, the way consumers interact with businesses has not changed much. behind the scenes, most companies still run on the same stack of crms, call centers, tickets, queues, and manual operational work. that is starting to change. consumers are beginning to use ai agents to compare offers, get support, change contracts, and book appointments. some will use the channels they know. others will expect their personal ai assistants to talk to companies for them. b2c companies need ai on their side of the conversation too.

germany's surgical system is structurally overloaded. 63% of all surgeries still happen inpatient, roughly twice the rate of comparable countries, at higher cost and with longer waiting times than necessary. around 4 million procedures a year could safely move to same-day ambulatory settings. the infrastructure to absorb them does not yet exist. tokura is closing that gap.

there is an unmet need for durable therapeutic treatments for cancer patients, as current drugs often lose their effectiveness over time. drug resistance therefore remains a major limiting factor to patient survival. basel-based tolremo is developing a new wave of novel resistance-breaking therapies by targeting the resistance-causing molecular mechanisms right from the start.

trekksoft offers a state-of-the-art, all-in-one booking software and payment gateway for tours, activities, and rentals, taking the tours and activities market online. tour and activity operators use trekksoft to sell on multiple channels, automate workflows, manage bookings and grow their business. founded in 2010 in interlaken, trekksoft today serves thousands of customers worldwide and processes millions of transactions.
tagline: the online booking solution for tour providers

description: uncommon provides the juicy, tender, and delicious meat you love without harming your health, the planet, or any animals. by utilizing a proprietary method to cultivate induced pluripotent stem cells (ipscs) from a single small biopsy, uncommon can create bacon and pork belly without harming any animals or requiring genetic modification.
tagline: a sustainable and cruelty-free approach to meat production

description: valink therapeutics is rethinking antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) with a new class: bispecific ADCs (bsADCs). their v-gate™ framework goes beyond incremental tweaks to identify rare biological synergies that boost efficacy, improve tolerability, and expand patient access.
tagline: unlocking the next frontier of cancer therapy

description: video content can generally only be discovered using manually created metadata such as tags (keywords) and descriptions. this is a major problem for video content owners, who want their content to be discoverable.

versantis is a clinical-stage biotech company developing novel drug therapies to treat liver, pediatric, and rare diseases, addressing currently unmet medical needs. based on its proprietary detoxification platform technology, versantis is pursuing innovative therapies for the critical care of serious liver conditions, such as acute-on-chronic liver failure or urea cycle disorder (ucd).
tagline: life saving therapies for liver and rare diseases

description: motivated by the belief that the conventional ticket sale industry no longer serves its customers, vivenu empowers global event organizers to take back control of their ticket sales. with a unified, powerful platform, organizers can create seamless customer experiences and unlock huge potential.

vivere’s vision is to create the next-generation of consumer brands and products. with exceptional speed to market, high quality standards and sustainable margins, vivere is building a platform that brings brands to international markets.

administration tasks for care workers are tedious and inefficient, lead to duplication of work, and can result in human error. with voize, caregivers can record documentation on their smartphones, freeing up their time to provide high-quality support to clients.

whaly’s mission is to grow data adoption among business users by empowering them to gain insights from the vast amounts of business data they generate. it makes data accessible to business operation teams by enabling them to execute their data projects without the need for engineers or data scientists.

zealy’s mission is to build the operating system for web3 communities. it aims to provide the right tools for managing, engaging, and growing the communities at the heart of web3. the zealy platform provides users with a variety of features, including crm functionalities, community analytics, referral mechanisms, customized onboarding flows, and quest and reward management.
tagline: building an operating system for web3 communities

description: zenjob is a full-service on-demand staffing platform addressing the most pressing pain points around short-term staffing. with zenjob, jobseekers can choose their part-time assignments on the go via mobile app and benefit from a wide selection of jobs on the zenjob platform. they also run through a structured onboarding process and receive continuous ratings “on the job”. this provides a pool of top quality manpower for employers, available within hours.
